## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and source/docs/runtime text are in English.
- [ ] No real keys, vaults, passwords, tokens, private host details, machine paths, or runtime artifacts are included.
- [ ] Tests use disposable fixtures, not production hosts or credentials.
- [ ] No unreviewed dependency version, crypto-profile, release/tag, or live-host change is bundled.
- [ ] Copyright/license notices and the MIT OR Apache-2.0 contribution terms are respected.
